error.registrationFailed: Registration could not be completed. Check the owner verification code and details, then try again.
error.registrationValidation: Some registration details were rejected. Check the owner phone, username, and password, then try again.
error.registrationVerificationMismatch: Verify the current owner phone number again before continuing.
error.registrationIncomplete: Registration did not return the required account details. Contact support before trying again.
error.registrationPending: The response timed out. Registration may still have been saved. Check its status before submitting again.
error.registrationStillPending: Registration is not confirmed yet. Wait briefly, then check the status again.
error.invalidVerification: Owner verification has expired or is invalid. Verify the owner phone again.
error.activationRejected: The activation service rejected this registration. Verify the owner again or contact support.
error.deviceEnrollmentFailure: This device could not be enrolled. Retry registration while connected to the internet.
error.deviceScopeConflict: This computer was linked to another business earlier; contact support.
error.deviceRevoked: This device was disabled; contact your administrator.
error.deviceSyncRecordConflict: Registration sync record conflict occurred. Contact support or verify device state.
error.secureStorageFailure: Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock or repair the device keychain, then retry.
error.databaseConstraintFailure: Registration conflicts with existing local data. Your existing data was preserved; contact support before retrying.
error.transactionFailure: Registration could not be saved completely. Your data was rolled back; retry safely.
error.registrationAlreadyCompleted: This business is already registered on this device. Continue to sign in.

account.description: Create the owner account used to sign in to this device. Your password stays in memory until registration finishes.
account.usernameHint: 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
account.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters and do not reuse your username.
account.usernameError: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
account.passwordError: Password must be 12–128 characters and different from the username.

terms.consent: I agree to the Terms and Conditions

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Registration completed before the app closed. Save these codes somewhere safe, then sign in with the username and password you chose.
recovery.savedConsent: I saved these codes somewhere safe
recovery.errorUnavailable: The pending registration recovery details are unavailable in secure storage. Retry or contact support.
recovery.errorStorage: Secure device storage is unavailable. Retry.
recovery.errorFinalize: Could not finalize recovery-code storage. Retry.
